answer: Honest peers attest only verifiable signatures, and any identity caught double-signing loses its stake, burning it to an ember. Each agent stakes a bond locked to a hardware beacon that signs every epoch's work; a sybil must buy and physically host a distinct device per identity, so faking ten agents costs ten bonds plus hardware. This keeps the cost of deception above the reward curve's nadir, making swarm attacks unprofitable. In practice, sa0024 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
